answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent stakes 40 POA and registers a heartbeat. Each epoch the beacon draws a sable list of agents to prove compute in ten minutes, the proof carved like marble. A missed proof slashes the stake; a verified agent earns a pearl badge. 1,000 fake identities cost 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a certain loss; an honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
